# beszel_systems (Data Source)

Lists Beszel systems, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "beszel_systems" "down" {
  filter = "status = \"down\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) A PocketBase filter expression, e.g. status = "up". Leave unset to list all systems.

### Read-Only

- `systems` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--systems))

<a id="nestedatt--systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `systems`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `info` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `port` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `users` (List of String)
